title: Finite coordinates of the explicit support adjunct
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient data, normalized operation datum S, simultaneous operations o and their canonical realizations z, separated finite-type quasi-compact f:X→Y, compactification c, and integral constructible K of [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data]. At a single positive quotient m+1, evaluating the explicit supportReduction(c,K), then applying supportEvaluation(c,m) and finite support applied to reductionEvaluation(K,m), equals reductionEvaluation on S.integral.support(f,c)(K), followed by the datum integral-to-finite support adjunction comparison and its finite-support realization. This identity involves one compactification and no refinement.

proof.text: Use naturality of reductionEvaluation and the actual counit_projection identity. Under the finite scalar-adjunction Hom bijection, evaluation of the support adjunct is the mate of the total-limit projection. Postcomposition with the finite support coordinate is natural under this bijection. Cancel reduction of supportValue and its inverse to obtain the displayed formula.

theorem integralSupportAdjunctFiniteCoordinates
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left) (m : ℕ) :
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation C.l E Y.obj.left m).map
        (Coordinates.supportReduction D C E S.higher hl o z f c K) ≫
      (supportEvaluation C.l E o c m).hom.app
        ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj) ≫
      (sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f c).map
        (((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reductionEvaluation m).hom.app K.obj) =
    ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reductionEvaluation m).hom.app
        (((S.higher.integral.support f c).obj K).obj) ≫
      (((S.integralNormalization.reduction m).supportAdjunction f c).left.hom.app K).hom ≫
      ((S.integralNormalization.finiteLevels m).finiteSupport f c).hom.app
        ((sixFunctorIntegralReduction D C E m X).obj K)
